page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top centre. Main text in two parallel columns of variant notes (left and right), with a centred heading "LIB. IX." between the two halves. Below the columns, a short line at right and two small marks at the foot. No marginal notes outside the columns.

page.notes: Two-column variant apparatus; the left and right columns are set against each other line by line and the transcription follows the printed line pairing. Several entries are abbreviated and some readings are uncertain (e.g. "Hiftrianorum", "Apollinenfes"). The foot marks at the bottom are unreadable symbols and are not transcribed.
